/mines2/fairness.derivation: block_i = HMAC_SHA256(key = serverSeed, message = clientSeed:nonce:i). Mine i of a round (i = 0, 1, …) is bytes 4i..4i+3 of block_0 ‖ block_1 ‖ … read as a big-endian number u; it is the tile at position floor(u × (N − i) / 2^32) among the tiles not yet picked, kept in ascending order — the same as floor(float × (N − i)) with float = Σ byte_j / 256^(j+1), the derivation public Mines calculators use on 25 tiles. A board with m mines is the first m picks.
/mines2/fairness.tiles: Tiles are numbered 0 to N − 1 from left to right, top to bottom.
rules: a board of 25, 36, 49 or 64 tiles with 1 to N − 1 mines; the mines are fixed by the seed pair and the nonce before the first tile is opened
a mine ends the round and pays nothing
after at least one safe tile the round can be cashed out; opening the last safe tile cashes it out by itself
a bet may name its tiles: they are opened in order and a round that meets no mine is cashed out at once
a round never pays more than its max win above the stake: a tile that would take the cash-out value past it is not opened
a payout is rounded down to the wallet's smallest unit (1e-8) once
a round left without a decision for 24 hours is finished by the server: with tiles open it is cashed out at its value; with none, tile 0 is opened and, if it is safe, the round is cashed out
/mines2/fairness.multiplier: after k safe tiles on N tiles with m mines a stake is paid × 99/100 × C(N, k) / C(N − m, k)
/mines2/fairness.return: 99% for every board and every number of tiles opened: C(N − m, k) / C(N, k) is the chance that k tiles are all safe
/mines2/fairness.summary: block_i = HMAC_SHA256(key = serverSeed, message = clientSeed:nonce:i). Mine i of a round (i = 0, 1, …) is bytes 4i..4i+3 of block_0 ‖ block_1 ‖ … read as a big-endian number u; it is the tile at position floor(u × (N − i) / 2^32) among the tiles not yet picked, kept in ascending order — the same as floor(float × (N − i)) with float = Σ byte_j / 256^(j+1), the derivation public Mines calculators use on 25 tiles. A board with m mines is the first m picks. Tiles are numbered 0 to N − 1 from left to right, top to bottom. The payout after k safe tiles on N tiles with m mines a stake is paid × 99/100 × C(N, k) / C(N − m, k), so the game returns 99% for every board and every number of tiles opened: C(N − m, k) / C(N, k) is the chance that k tiles are all safe. The server seed is committed up front by its SHA-256 hash and revealed when you rotate the pair, so every mine of a round is fixed before the bet and can be checked afterwards.
